decision: Fresh actual-placement evidence supports continued baseline retention; no clear placed-scale production defect demonstrated.
method: Official mu_bmd_import with ASCII-only action manifest parsing adapter, configured Blender5.2.2/SourceTools3.4.3. Shared StaticBatch01 diffuse review renderer. Fresh imports, no geometry modifications.
verification: All29 BMD/texture reference appearances match current Git bytes. All17 exact placement transforms AND model types matched independently decoded current World1. All3 evaluated bounds match retained old composition bounds exactly (delta0).

compositions.siege-wall: Exact old5 records within original650-radius selection about StoneMuWall04 local0; original camera and bounds. Main intentionally reproduces legacy upper-bar cropping; current-fit adds uncropped version. Mortar/timber distinguish clearly from walls and gate.

limits: Selective legacy masonry modules only; no terrain, surrounding unselected buildings, dynamic lighting, collisions, client or whole-map validation.
Reverse and fit views are new supplemental views; main views reproduce legacy composition, not claimed pixel-identical old images.
Reduced resolution is an offline readability cue, not calibrated client camera.
Coarse painted relief remains visible close up; retention is based on modular placed role, not failed studies or inability to edit.
portable_replay: python3 replay.py; set MU_REVIEW_REPO to repository location; MU_BLENDER and MU_BMDCONV optional. Legacy selection JSON retained locally so old branch is not needed to replay. Configured SourceTools env paths in replay.py.
